subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw make memorySearch.sync.intervalMinutes default to a non-zero fallback for unconfigured users, or keep periodic memory sync opt-in and solve watcher liveness another way?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the most direct fix changes default background sync behavior for existing users, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept bounded periodic fallback
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR after any code-scope fixes and upgrade proof show the 30-minute fallback is safe for existing users.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Leave the default at 0 and require a different repair such as watcher health warnings, doctor guidance, or explicit setup recommendation.

options.title: Request live outage proof first
options.body: Hold the default decision until a maintainer or contributor captures a live gateway watcher-silence reproduction and recovery transcript.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded periodic fallback
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR after any code-scope fixes and upgrade proof show the 30-minute fallback is safe for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently carried the current memory manager and memory search code and authored adjacent memory watcher repair work.
